title: Federation link writes terminal stderr before the control/monitor guard or stop fences it
outcome: Federation link writes terminal stderr before the control/monitor guard or stop fences it
acceptance: Terminal stderr for a federation link context is written only after the control/monitor guard or stop has fenced that context, or is suppressed for a fenced context; a deterministic regression shows no terminal output from a context fenced before the write.
Teardown timing, authority decisions and routing are otherwise unchanged; the candidate receives the standard independent review pair and exact-input validation.
